info.description:
Identity service of the e-commerce MVP: accounts, sign-in, customer and seller profiles, address book, regions, public seller lookup, admin review and moderation, and the internal API for other services.

Every success is `{ "data": ... }` (lists add `meta`); every error is `{ "error": { code, message, details, requestId } }` with a stable `code` from API §4.1. Send `X-Request-Id` to get it back in responses and errors.

get.description: RFC 7517 key set, not wrapped in `data`. Verify access tokens with it: RS256, `iss` ecommerce-identity, `aud` ecommerce-api. Not routed by the gateway.

post.description:
G-14, one lifecycle, no `scope` (sending it is a 400). Only this account, never other accounts of the same person; never an ADMIN account (403) or a seller that is not APPROVED (409). `reason` is a P-21d label, optionally `Label: description` (required for `Khác`): `Gian lận/lừa đảo` or `Khác` for a customer; also `Kinh doanh hàng cấm`, `Kinh doanh hàng giả/vi phạm sở hữu trí tuệ` for a seller.

The account's obligations are read again from Order (and Finance for a seller): open ones → BANNED with a limited session (`accessMode`); every one verified gone → DISABLED, every session revoked, restorable for 30 days (`restoreUntil`). A source that cannot answer → 503 and nothing is changed. Banning a banned account again changes and announces nothing.

**Permission:** `account:moderate`

post.description:
BANNED at any time; DISABLED until `restoreUntil` (409 ACCOUNT_RESTORE_WINDOW_EXPIRED after; nothing is deleted). Back to ACTIVE with the episode's timestamps cleared; cancelled orders, hidden products and unapproved seller rights are not restored. Already ACTIVE → 200 with nothing written. No `scope`.

**Permission:** `account:moderate`

post.description: Signs in to one account: `accountType` is the web app's channel (CUSTOMER, SELLER or ADMIN). Returns an access token (15 min) and the current profile; the refresh token is set as the HttpOnly `refresh_token` cookie (Path /api/v1/identity/auth), never in the body. Unknown email, wrong password and an account of another type all give the same error. A seller signs in only once approved. Limited per client IP; failed attempts never lock the account (P-18).
